verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe returned HTTP 200 for https://docs.trychannel3.com/llms.txt, which serves a markdown index of the docs. Channel3 also publishes an agent-oriented page at /developers/agents.md, and its doc pages are available as .md files. missing for 10: independent community corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs, evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Access 100 million+ products from 25,000+ brands through one API.
Pass any product URL and get structured metadata: pricing, variants, images, and merchant offers in a single response.
